decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than 28.08.2028, which is the expiry date of the original planning permission ref 25/02249/FUL.Reason: To comply with the Town and Country Act 1990 and in the interest of proper planning.

REPLACEMENT CONDITION 2The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan - P106 Block Plan - P107Proposed Ground and First Floor Plan - P103 Rev. 1 Proposed Front and Rear Elevations Plan - PR102 R1 Proposed Loft and Roof Plan - P104 Rev. 1Proposed Bicycle Storage - P104Planning Statement (received 19.03.2026)Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

REPLACEMENT CONDITION 3The use of the property as a House in Multiple Occupation hereby approved shall be occupied by a maximum of 6 people at any one time and shall not be subdivided or occupied as self-contained units.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed within all respective rooms. The communal kitchen, dining / living rooms shall be retained and maintained for their intended use in perpetuity.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

description: Variation of condition 2 and 3 of 25/02249/FUL to allow changes to the internal layout and increase maximum occupancy to 6 people facilitated by previously approved rear extension and loft conversion.
